author: Daniele Morais
title: Magnitude 5.9 earthquake strikes near Severo-Kuril’sk (Russia)
subtitle: The quake was recorded at a depth of 26 km, according to the US Geological Survey (USGS).
excerpt: A magnitude 5.9 earthquake was recorded near Severo-Kuril’sk (Russia), at a depth of 26 km, according to the USGS.
contentHtml:
A magnitude 5.9 earthquake was recorded on October 6, 2026 at 01:48 PM (Brasília time) near Severo-Kuril’sk (Russia), according to the United States Geological Survey (USGS). The quake occurred at a depth of roughly 26 km.

What this magnitude means

Earthquakes in this range are moderate and rarely cause severe structural damage, but are widely felt.

What to expect in the coming days

After a main shock, aftershocks — smaller quakes in the same region — are expected over the following days and weeks, with frequency decreasing over time, a well-established pattern in seismology.

With data from the USGS (United States Geological Survey).
